pages.title: Lullaby
pages.text: Poppy · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Poppy Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)In dreams I forget I am a guest, and snatch a moment of joy.$(br2)— Li Yu, Lang Tao Sha Ling

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Hostiles within 7 blocks become drowsy; phantoms stop hunting.$(br2)$(br2)Drowsiness 3:00
